page_title: NAP 1-0 LEC | Napoli v Lecce 26/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Paride Tremolada has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' Ante Rebic (Lecce) receives a yellow card for infringement.

90+2' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
90' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) receives a yellow card.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lecce, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
85' Antonio Conte prepares a substitution. Romelu Lukaku is replaced by Michael Folorunsho (Napoli).
83' Today's match ends for Santiago Pierotti who will be replaced by Remi Oudin (Lecce).

79' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) makes a yard for himself and attempts to endanger the goalkeeper with a long-range shot. His great effort, however, goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
78' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
77' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
77' It's time for a substitution. Ante Rebic (Lecce) comes on in place of Lassana Coulibaly.
74' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Paride Tremolada signals that the goal stands! The Napoli players celebrate.
74' The Napoli players halt their celebrations as referee Paride Tremolada makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
73' 1 - 0 Goal! Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 1:0.
72' Antonio Conte has decided to substitute Billy Gilmour and he is replaced by Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli).
72' The manager has decided to make a substitution and David Neres walks off the pitch to be replaced by Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli).
72' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out for a corner. Napoli can continue in their attacking effort.
71' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
69' Luca Gotti has decided to make a change. Nicola Sansone (Lecce) replaces Lameck Banda.
69' Here comes a substitution. Balthazar Pierret (Lecce) is brought on as a substitute for Hamza Rafia.
68' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) sends the corner into the box, but Alex Meret intercepts it and averts the threat.

68' Lameck Banda (Lecce) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The referee blows his whistle, Lecce are awarded a corner kick.
64' Billy Gilmour (Napoli) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
62' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.
62' Referee Paride Tremolada makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
61' Matteo Politano (Napoli) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
61' David Neres (Napoli) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
60' David Neres (Napoli) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Napoli have been awarded a corner kick.
58' The free kick is delivered by Hamza Rafia (Lecce) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
57' Billy Gilmour (Napoli) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
57' Here is a change. Cyril Ngonge is going off and Antonio Conte gives the last tactical orders to Matteo Politano (Napoli).

56' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Romelu Lukaku (Napoli), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Napoli.

55' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) has a great chance to score from deep inside the box! He creates some space for the shot, but blazes it high over the crossbar. Very bad attempt. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
55' The resulting corner from David Neres (Napoli) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
55' David Neres (Napoli) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Napoli force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
54' David Neres (Napoli) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong. The ball has crossed the sideline. Lecce are taking a throw-in.
51' Paride Tremolada shows a yellow card to Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) for his blatant foul.
51' Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but Wladimiro Falcone comes off his line to gather the ball.
48' A dangerous looking corner kick from Billy Gilmour (Napoli) is cleared to safety by the defence.
48' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lecce, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee signals a corner kick to Lecce.
47' Handball! A player from Napoli handled the ball. Lecce have a free kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
45+2' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The linesman points to the corner flag, Napoli are going to take it.

45+2' Lameck Banda (Lecce) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball into the stands. Nice run, but poor finish! The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Scott McTominay (Napoli) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
44' Scott McTominay (Napoli) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
43' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) launches a cross from the corner, but Wladimiro Falcone is alert to thwart the effort.

42' Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but Wladimiro Falcone easily deals with the threat. The ball is out of play. Napoli will have a chance to score from a corner.
41' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) takes the corner with a short pass.
40' Lameck Banda (Lecce) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lecce.
39' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
37' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the middle of the goal, but Wladimiro Falcone keeps it out with an amazing save.
36' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
35' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

34' Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
34' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) takes the corner.

33' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The ball is out of play. Lecce win a corner kick.
33' The corner is swung in but Napoli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
32' Scott McTominay (Napoli) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Napoli win a corner.
31' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
30' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

29' That was close! Scott McTominay (Napoli) makes a good run into the centre of the box and gets his head onto a lofted pass, but sends the ball a fraction over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
28' The goal by Napoli is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
27' Wait! Referee Paride Tremolada has indicated he is going to review the Napoli goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
26' Goal! Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) fires the rebound into the top left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
25' David Neres (Napoli) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Wladimiro Falcone is alert and denies him with a nice save.

23' A cross by Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
21' The ball is cleared after Lameck Banda (Lecce) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
19' Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) has tested the patience of referee Paride Tremolada and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
18' Andy Pelmard (Lecce) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alex Meret intercepts the ball.
17' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Wladimiro Falcone, who smothers the ball.
16' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) receives the ball and has a go from distance, but he shouldn't have bothered as it sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
14' Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom left corner, but Wladimiro Falcone is equal to it and makes an easy save.
14' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
13' David Neres (Napoli) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Paride Tremolada signals. Lecce get a free kick.
13' Lecce failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

12' Lameck Banda (Lecce) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out of play. Lecce are awarded a corner kick.
11' Napoli seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
9' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Mathias Olivera (Napoli) took the corner.
8' Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is behind the touchline and Napoli will take a throw-in.
7' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) jumps for a header from the resulting corner kick and sends the ball in on goal, but the goalkeeper makes a very good save.
7' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
6' The corner from Mathias Olivera (Napoli) is cleared away by the defence.
5' Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
4' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
2' Billy Gilmour (Napoli) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Paride Tremolada blows for a foul.
1' David Neres (Napoli) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Napoli will take a throw-in.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Napoli will kick-off.
Paride Tremolada is the one to supervise the game today.
